attributes.during:
Your ship is anchored at the Merchant Marina.

When you encounter a monster with the Merfolk trait, draw a random ally from the box and set it aside. If you defeat the monster, put the ally in your hand; otherwise, banish the ally.

You may add the total of the adventure deck numbers of the allies in your hand, if any, to your check to defeat a monster with the Merfolk trait.
